journal_lines: Did not make a sound. Not one. Three hours of perfect silence. Emerged with mud on the paws and a look you don't ask about.
Something in the deep dark was listening. Moved very slowly. Very quietly. It was enough.
The sculk was everywhere. Stayed still until the heartbeat noise stopped. Came back.
Walked on the sculk like walking on the back of a sleeping thing. It was a sleeping thing.
Held one breath. Then another. The dark held its breath with me.
Heard a footstep that was not a footstep. Did not investigate.
The blue eyes opened somewhere. Closed somewhere. Did not pass between.
Came back through the sculk garden quieter than I had gone in. There are ways to learn this.
